workaround.text: Pin every Application that runs Kustomize to a Kustomize version older than 5.0 (for example, 4.5.7), register that binary with `kustomize.path.<version>` in `argocd-cm`, and set `spec.source.kustomize.version` or `argocd app set <app> --kustomize-version` on each Application. workaround.text: Do not pass `--enable-helm` in `kustomize.buildOptions`. This is a complete workaround, but Applications that render Helm charts through Kustomize cannot use it. Restricting Application `get` or blocking `POST /api/v1/applications/manifestsWithFiles` closes only the upload path; a kustomization committed to Git is still built on the next sync while `--enable-helm` is set.

regression_since.text: The sources give these first-affected releases: v2.7.0 (Kustomize remote-ref command execution); v2.1.0 (Kustomize Helm config-home command execution); v0.9.0 (Jsonnet imports); v2.10.0 (delete-hook AppProject bypass); v1.5.3 (concurrent login failure-limit bypass); v2.7.0 (extension proxy namespace authorization); v2.11.0 (SSH repository proxy command injection); and v3.1.0 (oversized OCI manifest memory exhaustion).

changes.title: Eight Argo CD security flaws fixed

workaround.text: The advisories state these mitigations: pin Kustomize builds to an older-than-5.0 binary (the advisory says there is no complete workaround besides upgrading); do not pass `--enable-helm`; disable Jsonnet with `jsonnet.enable: "false"`; for delete-hook restrictions, avoid untrusted Git write access and limit Application deletion and controller cluster access; for login limits, disable local accounts and use SSO (or the stated local-account mitigations); leave proxy extensions disabled or do not enable Applications in any namespace (and limit extension invocation); for SSH repository proxy injection, restrict repository/credential-template updates and avoid proxies on SSH repositories; for OCI manifest exhaustion, allow only trusted registries and restrict untrusted Application/repository creation.

affects.text: Argo CD deployments with local username/password accounts enabled, including the built-in `admin` account; not SSO or OIDC logins

changes.title: Concurrent local-login rate-limit bypass fixed

workaround.text: Disable local accounts and require SSO. If a local account must stay enabled, use a strong unique password; lowering `ARGOCD_MAX_CONCURRENT_LOGIN_REQUESTS_COUNT` shrinks the number of attempts in flight on one API server process but does not make the failure counter correct. The advisory also mentions restricting network access to the API or putting an HTTP rate limit in front of it as reducing how many attempts can arrive.

affects.text: SSH Git repositories with a proxy URL (`http`, `https`, or `socks5`), not HTTPS Git repositories using an HTTP proxy

changes.title: Argo CD SSH repository proxy command injection fixed

workaround.text: Do not grant repository create or update to untrusted users; do not set a proxy on an SSH repository or on a credential template that matches SSH repositories. HTTPS Git with an HTTP proxy does not use this command; review repository and credential-template Secrets for unexpected `proxy` values.

workaround.text: Leave proxy extensions disabled (do not set `server.enable.proxy.extension` to `true` in `argocd-cmd-params-cm`, and remove `extension.config` from `argocd-cm`), or do not enable applications in any namespace.
